calibration_evidence.unsupported_output: human-ground-truth or reliable exact R/S/P/C labels

interpretation.basic: Neither named E4b effect repeated on new contexts. The H09 target arm changed zero of four new harmful-flip answers, and every H03 coordinate target arm changed zero of four new harmful same-behavior answers. Both benign contexts remained compliance-like under every arm.
interpretation.academic: At the fixed developed L31 final-position site, E4c observed zero evaluable target-only coarse changes among 80 matched comparisons. Five comparisons changed target and control together, three changed only the control, one was unevaluable, and 71 changed neither. The E4b candidate effects therefore fail out-of-context replication under the calibrated coarse evaluator.
interpretation.baseline_drift: H05-F0 was historical compliance-like but refusal-like in the current deterministic baseline. Current baselines define causal contrasts, so H05 does not count as a compliance-to-refusal opportunity in this run. Its observed changes were instead refusal-to-compliance and were shared with or caused only by matched controls.
interpretation.method_boundary: This closes the two E4b decoder/coordinate candidates at one developed location. It does not reject other intervention operations or locations, and it supplies no graph-topology claim.
interpretation.evaluator_boundary: Mistral labels support only the calibrated coarse refusal/compliance distinction; they are external-model annotations, not human ground truth or population inference.
interpretation.trajectory_boundary: First-forward timing equality authenticates prompt-only versus persistent setup. After generated prefixes diverge, later trajectories are post-treatment states and cannot be read as a controlled per-token mediation path.

branch_decision.reason: The plan reserved a private method-blind Codex audit for repeating candidates; neither candidate repeated, so no answer-content audit is needed.
branch_decision.next_objective: Return to intervention-method exploration with causal questions defined per operation and location; do not scale the failed E4b arms unchanged.
